assumptions: The organism's codon usage table is the one named.
Each strategy (maximise CAI, match usage, harmonise) is DnaChisel's.
limits: Variants to try, not a prediction of which expresses best.
Codon choice only: promoter, RBS and plasmid copy number are elsewhere.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which codon-optimised variants of this CDS does an expression trial need, and how do they differ?

description: The expression-design deliverable: several coding sequences for one protein, each variant following a different published strategy (maximise codon adaptation, match the host's codon usage, harmonise with the native host, or preserve the initiation region), each scored by an engine — CAI, GC, the folding energy of the Kudla -4..+37 initiation window, and rare codons. It returns the comparison rather than one answer, because the strategies disagree about what limits expression and the researcher picks. Refuses a frame-shifted CDS, an internal stop or a missing host table rather than optimising nonsense.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

avoid_patterns.description: literal patterns (restriction sites, homopolymers) every variant must not contain.

cds.description: the coding sequence to redesign, in frame and start-codon first. Unset falls back to THE SELECTION, on the strand the selection or its matching annotation states, then to the whole open record.

feature.description: redesign this annotated CDS or gene by NAME instead of the selection, exactly as `codon_usage_analysis` takes one. Its own strand is used. Takes precedence over the selection; `cds` still wins over both.

gc_max.description: maximum GC fraction (0-1); set with gc_min. Advanced.

gc_min.description: minimum GC fraction (0-1); set with gc_max. Advanced.

gc_window.description: window in bp the GC bounds apply over (whole sequence when unset). Advanced.

genetic_table.description: genetic code for the translation constraint (default Standard). Advanced.

host_table.description: the TARGET host's codon-usage table, BY NAME, as the Codon Usage panel lists it. This is the way to pass a table: it resolves against the tables loaded in this project, so the numbers come from a table someone built or fetched. Leave unset and the active table is used.

host_table_name.description: how to name that table on every score it produced (e.g. "E. coli K-12, Kazusa"), so a reported CAI is attributable.

host_table_tsv.description: ONLY for a table you are pasting yourself, measured elsewhere — prefer `host_table`, which names one this project already has. Do NOT write a table out from memory: codon frequencies are measured data, and a typed one is indistinguishable from a real one in the result. TSV: codon<TAB>count. Advanced.

native_table.description: the gene's NATIVE host codon table, BY NAME from this project's loaded tables — required only for the `harmonize` posture, which matches relative adaptiveness BETWEEN two hosts. It must be a DIFFERENT table from `host_table`: harmonising a host against itself is a difference of zero.

native_table_tsv.description: ONLY for a native table you are pasting yourself — prefer `native_table`. Do not write one out from memory (see `host_table_tsv`). TSV: codon<TAB>count. Advanced.

postures.description: which strategies to design, in order. max_cai = every amino acid takes the target host's single most-used codon; match_usage = reproduce the target host's synonymous-codon distribution rather than its single best codon, so rare codons stay at their natural rate; harmonize = put each codon at the same relative adaptiveness it had in the gene's native host, so the elongation rhythm (and any pause the protein folds around) survives the transfer; native_initiation = leave nt +1…+37 of the coding sequence exactly as they are and match the host's codon usage only downstream, so the redesign cannot add secondary structure to the window Kudla found dominant. The set IS the deliverable — asking for one gets one, and there is no hidden default of three.

rare_below.description: within-family frequency below which a codon counts as RARE, for the report only — it adds no constraint. Omit and no rare-codon count is reported, which is the honest answer: "rare" has no host-independent definition.

seed.description: seed for the solver's random draws, so a listed variant can be regenerated exactly. Advanced.

upstream.description: the bases immediately 5' of the CDS (the 5'UTR/RBS region). Kudla's window starts 4 nt BEFORE the start codon, so without this the folding energy is reported over a truncated window and says so.

name: design_expression_variants

best_cai.description: the posture reaching the highest CAI — a ranking on ONE axis, never a recommendation

distinct.description: how many of the variants are DIFFERENT sequences

least_structured.description: the posture whose initiation window folds least tightly (the highest, least-negative dG)

protein.description: the protein every variant encodes — asserted per variant, not assumed

records.description: the variants as sequence RECORDS, so the run leaves the user holding the designs it describes

region.description: what was actually redesigned — the selection when there is one, otherwise the whole open record, naming the STRAND and where it came from. Empty when the caller passed `cds` outright, because then there is no region, only a sequence they named

report.description: the whole comparison as Markdown — table, what each design trades, the provenance of every number, and the sequences — so it survives outside the transcript

skipped.description: postures that were asked for and could not run, each with the reason

variants.description: one entry per posture: its sequence, what it was optimising for, what it trades away, and every score with the engine that produced it
